claims.paraphrased_claim: Immune response to infection can cause life-threatening organ dysfunction in sepsis
claims.boundary: Sepsis is not simply infection, ordinary inflammation or autoimmune disease.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Vessel lining dysfunction and leakage can contribute to sepsis-related injury
claims.boundary: Illustrative pathway; not a complete causal account or measured patient trajectory.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Clotting in small vessels and impaired circulation can reduce organ delivery
claims.boundary: Use can; no universal complete blockage or flow-rate number.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Reduced perfusion can impair oxygen supply and organ function
claims.boundary: Oxygen utilization and other injury pathways also matter; no single-pathway definition.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Sepsis can include impaired/suppressed immune defenses
claims.boundary: Not a linear all-patients inflammation-then-suppression timeline; no immune-suppression recommendation.

claims.paraphrased_claim: Sepsis is an emergency; early treatment is important
claims.boundary: No self-diagnosis checklist, drug advice or guarantee.

claims.paraphrased_claim: NIH/NIAID source depicts neutrophil ingestion of MRSA
claims.boundary: Still source shows phagocytosis, not sepsis or continuous motion; colors assigned.
